notes: Client (management-console) Wallet & Balance .Mng sections. sourceSelector targets the T2 SoT `.wbc-*` classes from wallet-client.jsx; destinationSelector targets the Falcon Angular management-console wallet. The live destination requires client auth + a selected org node to render the table, so destination falls back to full page until an authenticated capture is wired (web-scrub bearer-inject + node-select). The transfer drawer (`.wb-drawer`) only mounts after clicking a per-row `.wbc-xfer-btn`, so it is not auto-captured by a single goto.
